$comment: 2026-10-29 validation.json is the protocol freeze snapshot and is deliberately unchanged. This file records the charting instrument v0.3.1 freeze that repairs limitation F1.
limitation_repaired: F1 — evidence_state was not coupled to dimension content or provenance

decisions.boolean_encoding: tri-state true|false|null for the six boolean fields (null required in non-reported states)
decisions.open_science_enums: removed the not_reported member from data_availability and code_availability; absence is carried by evidence_state
decisions.conflict_anchoring: conflicting requires >=2 content anchors (provenance + additional_provenance) and a narrative_summary; no value may be asserted
decisions.publication_type: study_reports.primary_publication_type stays required and non-null in every state (bibliographic metadata, not a finding)

test_matrix.regression: a row accepted by v0.3.0 is refused by v0.3.1 (R1)

outstanding: no charting row has been produced under v0.3.1 yet; the first dual-coded rows are the acceptance test for the codebook wording
the v0.2 positive-translation check is limited to the design; no v0.2 row has been mechanically translated yet
